summary: Single-engine plane approaching Telluride Regional Airport crashed around 1:30 p.m. Thursday (Thanksgiving Day) after witnesses saw it go down; took authorities about an hour to find the site in rough terrain; both people aboard killed; identities unreleased at publication.
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff's Office, San Miguel County SAR, Telluride Fire Protection District, coroner
notes: Denver Post story syndicated by Aviation Pros. Sheriff Bill Masters: "It's a really unfortunate Thanksgiving Day tragedy." FAA/NTSB notified; date = crash date (Thanksgiving 2020, Thursday).
